# Forum debate: Plagueis vs pre-boost TPM Sidious (Suspect Insight)

**URL:** https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t394-plagueis-vs-pre-boost-tpm-sidious
**Pages read:** 1 of 1 (17 posts). Raw: `forum-raw/t394_pg1.html`, `t394.c.txt`.

## Conditions
Darth Plagueis vs TPM Sidious *before* the power boost after Plagueis's death. One fight.

## Arguments for SIDIOUS
- **LOTL:** "canonically better"; "Sidious has all of Plagueis's knowledge".
- Also for Sidious: PeraltaEagle45, EmperorCaedus, and later DC77.

## Arguments for PLAGUEIS
- **Guest (main rebuttal):**
  - Knowledge ≠ mastery.
  - Plagueis has midichlorian manipulation.
  - Sidious feared Plagueis's "sorcerer's ways".
  - James Luceno said Plagueis could undermine his apprentice.
- **CuckedCurry:** Plagueis 8/10.
- **dark_globe:** Sidious is in for the "fight of his life".
- Also for Plagueis: DC77 (at first), Shioz, HellfireUnit, AlexSerp.

## Counterarguments and rebuttals that seemed to land
- "Sidious has all his knowledge" → knowledge ≠ mastery, plus the "sorcerer's ways" fear (Guest). **Landed** with the majority.
- Note DC77 moved from Plagueis to Sidious within the thread. Compare his t1921 stance, where Plagueis is "a huge end of novel power up+a decade of constant growth away from Sidious", so post-boost Sidious is far above Plagueis.

## Verdict tally (POSTER OPINION)
Plagueis 6 (CuckedCurry, Guest, Shioz, HellfireUnit, AlexSerp, dark_globe). Sidious 4 (PeraltaEagle45, LOTL, EmperorCaedus, DC77 final). DC77 is counted once, by his final vote.

## Scaling chains
- Pre-boost Sidious < Plagueis < post-boost TPM Sidious (implied by the thread's premise and DC77 elsewhere).

## Conflicts with our notes
- **Supported, and it cuts against LOTL:** `sidious-comicvine-respect.txt` (Darth Plagueis novel): "he couldn't be certain he had learned all of Plagueis' secrets - 'his sorcerer's ways,' as the Sun Guards referred to them - including the ability to prevent beings from dying." That contradicts "Sidious has all of Plagueis's knowledge".
- **Not in our notes:** the Luceno "undermine his apprentice" statement.

## Original-work check (added 2026-10-11)
Each quote, scan or feat cited above, with its original work. "Named in thread" means a poster gave the work. "From our notes" means the same quote is in one of our files, with the source shown there. "NOT IDENTIFIED" means neither the thread nor our notes give the work. Those are left unsourced, not guessed. Poster verdicts and opinions are not listed.
- "his sorcerer's ways" fear → *Darth Plagueis* (novel), from our notes: `sidious-comicvine-respect.txt` L579-580. Chapter not given.
- Plagueis's midichlorian manipulation → *Darth Plagueis* (novel) is the work, but no passage was cited in the thread.
- "James Luceno said Plagueis could undermine his apprentice" → the medium/date is not given. NOT IDENTIFIED.

- (2026-10-19) IDENTIFIED: the Luceno "undermine his apprentice" line is from the Del Rey Star Wars Books Facebook Q&A, Jan 25 2012. Q: "Do you feel that, had it come to a contest of lightsabers or Force powers, Sidious would have prevailed anyway?" A: "If it had come to a duel, I think Plagueis may have found a way to undermine his apprentice." Transcript: https://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/James_Luceno_Facebook_QA_Recap_143276.asp (also Club Jade, Roqoo Depot). Same Q&A: "Palpatine probably never thought of himself as an apprentice, and Plagueis never really treated him as an underling."
